name: foilspf_ax
note: Engine twin of mode_specs/foilspf.json (Phase C2b, docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-27-c2b-anakit-analyses-design.md): the same knobs, geometry, objectives and columns, run by the contract engine on SimJob MDC2025ax (Code_mdc2025ax.tar.bz2), with sob and flash computed by anakit (kit anakit) instead of the pipeline's harvest. Its own v2 board starts empty: rows measured on another release cannot be mixed in. The original's note explains the geometry.

lines.comment: === foilspf (10D profile mode) === {n_foils} free foils, no pinned base
rOut  profile: {rOut_0:.2f} -> {rOut_1:.2f} -> {rOut_2:.2f} mm (Lagrange quadratic, u = i/48)
extent {extent:.1f} mm over 48 gaps -> deltaZ {deltaZ:.6f} mm; centre pinned at z0 {z0:.1f}

EXTENT CEILING 1100 -> 1700 -> 2000, measured 2026-08-02 after foilspf02 PINNED 1100 (its two best new Pareto points both sat exactly on the bound). The stack is CENTRE-pinned at z0=5871 and grows SYMMETRICALLY, so the ceiling is whichever edge hits a wall first. All bounds are LIVE-PREFLIGHT measured at the WORST corner (rOut 120/120/120, hT .15/.15/.15, solid f=0 -> maximal material, so a PASS certifies the whole box at that extent): 1100 PASS 0 overlaps, 1400 PASS 0, 1700 PASS 0, 1800 FAIL, then with EMC_Source moved 5000 -> 4850: 1900 PASS 0, 2000 PASS 0, 2100 FAIL. THE STOPPING RULE: extend only by moving MASSLESS bookkeeping volumes, never real material. EMC_Source is a 20um vacuum disc nothing in this chain reads, so it is movable; it was walked 5300 -> 5000 -> 4850, staying above EMC_Source2 (4800) so VD ordering is preserved. That is now as far as it goes, because the DOWNSTREAM wall is real: at 2100 the second overlap is VirtualDetector_ST_Out vs protonabs1 (250um) -- ST_Out is placed FROM the target's own downstream end, so it rides the stack outward and reaches the absorber at extent ~2060, and unlike EMC_Source it cannot be relocated out of the way. Walls: upstream 2*(5871-4850)=2042, downstream ~2060 (material). 2000 keeps the same 42mm margin the 1100/1142 and 1700/1742 pairs used.

protonabsorber.distFromTargetEnd {ipa_dist:.3f} (stock 625). Offline places the IPA at targetEnd+distFromTargetEnd -- i.e. RELATIVE to the stopping target -- but the IPA is fixed hardware at z=6901-7901. Without this compensation a longer target slides the absorber the same distance downstream as a RIGID body (length is unchanged: pabs1halflen saturates at the protonabsorber.halfLength=500 cap), which both mis-simulates real in-beam material and pushes its support wires out of DS2Vacuum. This holds the absorber at its true absolute position for any extent; at extent 800 it returns the stock 625 exactly. Measured with protonabsorber.verbosityLevel=1: 6901.02-7901.02 at extent 400, 800 and 1100, identical to stock.

EMC_Source relocated 5300 -> 5000 (2026-07-31) -> 4850 (2026-08-02). It is a 20um disc of ds.vacuumMaterial (vd.halfLength=0.01) -- ZERO mass, no scattering, no absorption -- and NO foils-family stage reads virtual detectors (only pot_only instantiates ReadVirtualDetector), so moving it is physics-neutral. Moving it BEATS disabling it: the VD and its ordering vs EMC_Source2 (4800, which is why 4850 is the floor for this key) are preserved for any future consumer. It is the UPSTREAM wall of the zero-overlap corridor -- at 5300 it capped the stack at 971mm, at 5000 at 1742, at 4850 at 2042. zEMCSourceInMu2e is a plain c.getDouble default at VirtualDetectorMaker.cc:189, so each move is one config line, no source patch. Do NOT walk it below 4800 to buy more range: the binding wall past ~2042 is DOWNSTREAM and made of real material (ST_Out vs protonabs1), so further upstream moves buy nothing.

protonabsorber.zStartInMu2e 6901.02: ABSOLUTE pin, authoritative under the patched GeometryService (maker substitutes targetEnd = zStartInMu2e - distFromTargetEnd, so placement is 6901.02 exactly; see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-31-ipa-absolute-position-design.md). The distFromTargetEnd expression above STAYS as the fail-safe: an unpatched lib ignores this key and the expression alone still places the absorber at 6901.02 (cylindrical IPA, OutRadius0 == OutRadius1 == 300.5, so the two routes are degenerate). Consistency pinned by tests/test_foilspf_spec.py.
POISON PILL: an unpatched StoppingTargetMaker ignores holeRadii and reads
this scalar. 1e6 forces a loud G4Tubs crash instead of a silently uniform
stack -- emitting a 'sensible' scalar is how 62 foilsg rows were lost.
Degrader parked at 120 deg (mmackenz hardware detent)

TT_MidInner -> DS2Vacuum workaround REMOVED 2026-07-28 (Run1Bap migration) -- see mode_specs/foilsflash.json for the full mechanism. Short version: v13_12_10 parented tracker VDs on `isDumbbell` so they landed in DS2Vacuum while the tracker sat in DS3Vacuum (GeomMgt0002 fatal); the override forced agreement. v13_32_10 keys VD parenting on !tracker.inDS2Vacuum, making stock self-consistent -- and keeping the override is what held the last EMC_0_Front overlap.
